name: vizmatic
description: Make explainer films, dense technical diagrams, charts, and docs figures from code, then check and render them.

interface.shortDescription: Make explainer films, narrated lessons, and dense figures
interface.longDescription: Use Vizmatic to write vector explainer films, narrated lessons, and dense technical figures from code, check them for layout and motion defects, and render MP4, WebM, GIF, PNG, and SVG.
defaultPrompt: Use $vizmatic to explain this mechanism with a short animated film, check it, and export MP4.
Use $vizmatic to create a dense architecture diagram and render dark and light PNG files.
